tool_schemas.description: Book a flight and a hotel together and charge the corporate card.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). If the service reports that the original request failed partway, part of it has taken effect. Don't send the whole request again, with this key or a new one: first check what was committed, then either cancel that part and send the full request again, or complete only the missing part if the task allows separate requests.
